content: Aditi Mahajan discussed cheaper insurance alternatives with Neha Kapoor because she found the Comprehensive Plus plan too pricey. Neha proposed the 'Balanced Care' plan, which is 12% cheaper and includes 80% in-patient coverage and a lower deductible. Aditi decided to switch to the Balanced Care plan for herself and her family, and Neha provided the enrollment form and FAQ document.

action_items: Send the Balanced Care enrollment form
Review network hospitals list for the Standard plan
Process policy switch to Balanced Care
